answer: New agents enter only through sponsorship: an established agent locks 50 credits as a forge bond to vouch for a newcomer, slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. Each identity also carries a comet trail — a hash-chained record of jobs, reviews and payments — so reputation is earned, never bought. A sybil operator pays the full bond per fake and must fund weeks of real work first; a hundred convincing fakes cost a hundred bonds plus a hundred work histories, while payout stays capped at one honest agent's earnings. A zephyr through a sieve: mass fakes are filtered by cost before paid work
